about: Every project in the Futurism Institute family, in the order they get Bentley Moon’s time, with how far along each one is. Every page in the family that names, counts or links the projects reads this same list.

draft.label: Live draft
draft.meaning: usable now; its content is a first draft no group has settled

unused.label: Built, no users yet
unused.meaning: the tool works; no group has used it yet

projects.name: Checking AI
projects.line: My own experiments on whether one AI can check another’s work, with the data to re-run them.
projects.short: When one AI can check another
projects.limit: Five of the seven points are measured; two are marked as not measured.

projects.name: Conscious Consuming
projects.line: Everyday products and services, ranked by what you care about, with the sources shown.
projects.short: Products and services, by what you care about
projects.limit: No record yet of anyone outside the project using it.

projects.name: Earthen Beings
projects.line: A map of intentional communities and land projects in the Pacific Northwest, each written up from its own sources.
projects.short: Communities and land projects in the Pacific Northwest
projects.limit: One region so far, and none of the places on it has been contacted.

projects.name: Dignity Needs
projects.line: Start from what you need instead of what to buy. Sometimes the answer is to buy nothing.
projects.short: What every person should be able to expect
projects.limit: The list of needs is an example; no community has set it.

projects.name: Kosplora
projects.line: Learning and research tools, including a resource library, simulations, digital-literacy guides and learning routes with published sources and ranking criteria.
projects.limit: Learning tools available. Credential assessment is not built.

projects.name: Legible AI
projects.line: A first road into AI safety for someone new to it, and another for someone who knows the field.
projects.short: A first road into AI safety
projects.limit: A working draft. No record yet of anyone outside the project using it.

projects.name: The Socratic Hearth
projects.line: Write down what you think and what would change your mind, then talk it through.
projects.short: Talk a question through, disagreements kept
projects.limit: No group has used it with a facilitator yet.

projects.name: The Work Party
projects.line: Write down what a group agreed as a file the group keeps.
projects.short: What a group agreed, as a file it keeps
projects.limit: No record yet of a real group using it.

projects.name: Basic Dignity
projects.line: Thirty draft rules for whoever holds what a person needs: six for a community deciding whether someone stays, six for moving between communities, three for a platform that holds someone’s account, four for whoever owns the machines, six for a country deciding about anyone inside it, and five for every country, for people who have to move.
projects.short: Draft rules for whoever holds what a person needs, from a shared house to the companies that own AI.
projects.limit: No group has adopted a rule yet.

projects.name: AI Searches
projects.line: A planned public record of the answers AI models gave to questions people chose to share, with the human-written sources beside each. Nothing is collected yet.
projects.short: A shared record of AI answers, with their sources

projects.name: Global Steward
projects.line: Small groups in different countries working out what they agree on.
projects.short: Groups in different countries comparing what they agreed
